title: Add JSON output for A2A status
summary: Add stable machine-readable output for `covenant a2a status --json` so operators and autonomous supervisors can inspect queued tasks, in-flight leases, and pending results without parsing JSONL or human text.
expectedFailureModes: Automation treats the default status output as stable despite its mixed human/JSONL shape.
`--json` emits multiple lines or non-JSON text to stdout, breaking supervisors that consume one object.
The queue status payload omits the stale-lease filter parameters needed to correlate an operator view with its repair decision.
nextAction: Continue with the next autonomy backlog item.
